status_meaning.PASS: named executable regression covers the specified essential behavior
status_meaning.PARTIAL: related behavior tested but at least one condition lacks executable proof
status_meaning.GAP: specific scenario has no direct executable regression; blocks Step 2 closure

entries.description: attempt transient fail 且 retry budget exists
entries.criterion: Node=REMEDIATION_PENDING，下游保持 PENDING 而非 BLOCKED
entries.assessment: 同一逻辑节点 transient-clean 重试；子节点保持等待

entries.description: retry budget耗尽
entries.criterion: Node=FAILED，ordinary descendants 转 BLOCKED
entries.assessment: 预算耗尽后依赖链 BLOCKED

entries.description: Writer SUCCEEDED 后 verification triggers repair
entries.criterion: old accepted_handoff 立即失效；Reviewer 不可提前 READY
entries.assessment: 旧 Handoff 撤销和 Reviewer 回 PENDING

entries.description: Writer 已被普通 downstream SUCCEEDED 消费后再触发 repair
entries.criterion: REPAIR_SCOPE_INVALIDATED，P1 fail closed
entries.assessment: 已成功消费的下游使 reopen fail closed

entries.description: upstream FAILED 有多层 descendants
entries.criterion: descendants BLOCKED，但 Task aggregation 只保留 root failure ownership
entries.assessment: 多层阻塞与 root 独立聚合

entries.description: local node cancellation
entries.criterion: node=CANCELLED；ordinary descendants BLOCKED
entries.assessment: 本地节点取消可 cancel+join；不取消全 Task；下游阻塞；precommit 撤销、dirty fail-close 和终态拒绝专测

entries.description: task-wide cancellation
entries.criterion: running nodes cancel+join；未运行 descendants=CANCELLED，不误标 business failure
entries.assessment: Task user cancel + active join + 未启动节点 CANCELLED

entries.description: Verification failure @ R5，Repair lock 时 Workspace=R6
entries.criterion: 不向 Coder注入旧 failure；先 refresh/reverify 或 REPAIR_FEEDBACK_STALE
entries.assessment: 旧反馈不得调度，自动规范 refresh 或严格 fail-close；fresh canonical revision 绑定

entries.description: own AcceptanceFailure 后 current revision 改变
entries.criterion: 重跑 deterministic acceptance；旧 Feedback 不原地复用
entries.assessment: 实际发生写入的 Writer own AcceptanceFailure 经独立 canonical verdict 认证；R+1 stale 后重评估并重新生成 verdict/ref，HOLDS 时不执行多余 Repair

entries.description: stale feedback refresh 后仍失败
entries.criterion: 创建新的 EvidenceRef / observed revision / fingerprint，再允许 REPAIR
entries.assessment: 新 REVERIFY attempt、attested receipt / EvidenceRefs / AttributionRef / feedback fingerprint 全部换代

entries.description: stale feedback refresh 后已通过
entries.criterion: 旧 RepairFeedback 作废，不执行多余 repair
entries.assessment: 新 check HOLDS 时撤销旧反馈、零次额外 Writer 执行；不可凭旧 Handoff 假成功，转安全终态

entries.description: single business Writer + one deterministic failed check
entries.criterion: binding singleton → UNIQUE_WRITER，target=current accepted_attempt
entries.assessment: canonical failure + singleton owner + current accepted attempt

entries.description: single Writer + multiple deterministic failed checks
entries.criterion: 每个 check 都绑定同一 singleton Writer → UNIQUE_WRITER
entries.assessment: 两个 failed checks 都由同一实际 business Writer 负责

entries.description: two business Writers → global verification fail
entries.criterion: candidate set >1 → MULTI_WRITER；不生成 automatic RepairFeedback
entries.assessment: 两个真实 business Writer，compiled candidate 非 singleton → MULTI_WRITER

entries.description: Writer B 是最后执行者但 A/B 都是 candidates
entries.criterion: 禁止 last-writer heuristic；仍 MULTI_WRITER
entries.assessment: 后执行 Writer B 不成为 last-writer heuristic

entries.description: failed stack trace/path 只与 Writer A changed_paths 重合
entries.criterion: path overlap 不缩小 authority candidate set
entries.assessment: 修改 accepted changed_paths 后仍不缩窄编译归因 scope

entries.description: Tester prose 声称“Writer A caused failure”
entries.criterion: self-report 不影响 attribution
entries.assessment: 真实 FakeBackend 测试描述宣称 Writer A 负责，解析器无权采信

entries.description: 一个 failed check 无 owner，另一个属于 Writer A
entries.criterion: NO_OWNER / no automatic repair；不能只修可归因子集
entries.assessment: 一 check 无 owner 时全局 NO_OWNER

entries.description: failed checks 分别绑定 Writer A / Writer B
entries.criterion: MULTI_WRITER；不任选其一
entries.assessment: 分属 A/B 的 failed checks 全局 MULTI_WRITER

entries.description: Writer attempt1 clean retry fail、attempt2 accepted，随后 verify fail
entries.criterion: target_write_attempt=attempt2
entries.assessment: writer retry accepted attempt2 优先于旧 attempt1

entries.description: Tester 修改 tracked repo 后测试失败
entries.criterion: repository_state_unchanged=false → SOURCE_INELIGIBLE；不归因 Writer
entries.assessment: 真实临时 Git 库 Tester 修改 tracked source 后，Git digest 变化，旧 revision 的 canonical check 被拒且任务 fail-closed

entries.description: verifier backend crash / test command 未形成 deterministic result
entries.criterion: SOURCE_INELIGIBLE；不把 execution failure 当 verification failure
entries.assessment: 实际 Verifier backend crash 导致 QUARANTINED；即使伪造 deterministic tool proof 亦无法取得 REPAIR owner

entries.description: verification only UNVERIFIED
entries.criterion: 不触发 repair attribution
entries.assessment: 仅 UNVERIFIED 没有合法自动修复归因

entries.description: semantic READ_ONLY Tester 有 physical WRITE lock
entries.criterion: 不进入 business writer candidate set
entries.assessment: physical WRITE verifier 的 semantic WorkKind 不成为 business writer

entries.description: same Provider 执行两个 IMPLEMENTATION logical nodes
entries.criterion: 仍是两个 candidates；Provider identity 不合并 ownership
entries.assessment: 两个实际 Writer 共用 Provider 也不合并

entries.description: singleton Writer accepted 后，另一个 business Writer 改 Git-visible state，再运行 verifier
entries.criterion: SCOPE_INVALIDATED；不沿用旧 singleton attribution
entries.assessment: 真实 Git repo Writer B 修改 tracked 文件，Runtime 捕获 post digest；Canonical 归因 SCOPE_INVALIDATED

entries.description: UNIQUE_WRITER attribution 后 Scheduler reopen
entries.criterion: Writer reopen + old handoff revoke 先于 READY recomputation，无旧 handoff 解锁窗口
entries.assessment: reopen authority revoke 先于 READY 重算

entries.description: WRITE execution terminal fail + mutation observed + quiescence proven
entries.criterion: Task=FAILED；WorkspaceSession=FROZEN；WorkspaceDisposition=STABLE，不误标 QUARANTINED
entries.assessment: 真实 Git tracked 修改 + dirty terminal WRITE、backend quiescent；Task FAILED，FROZEN 且显式 physical attribution complete 时 STABLE，不误 QUARANTINED

entries.description: WRITE failure mutation UNKNOWN + no legal remediation
entries.criterion: task-wide fail closed；剩余 ordinary nodes 不再 dispatch
entries.assessment: UNKNOWN mutation 关闭 task dispatch

entries.description: dirty root failure 时另有 unrelated READY branch
entries.criterion: unrelated branch → BLOCKED + TASK_FAIL_CLOSED，不允许继续污染共享状态
entries.assessment: 无关 READY 阻止并撤销 ticket

entries.description: dirty failure 后 planned Reviewer 尚未运行
entries.criterion: Reviewer 不 dispatch；不会为了“诊断”重新打开 Agent execution
entries.assessment: Reviewer 被 TASK_FAIL_CLOSED 阻断；无 REVIEW claim，受撤销票无 backend execution，finalization 不重启 agent

entries.description: FROZEN dirty workspace finalization
entries.criterion: 只允许 Runtime-owned repository digest / changeset / evidence aggregation
entries.assessment: FROZEN 后仅 deterministic finalizer 获取 Git digest/changeset/TaskEvidenceRef，失效 ticket 不执行其他 Agent

entries.description: dirty failed task + Git-visible patch present
entries.criterion: TaskResult FAILED + PATCH_PRESENT + RESIDUAL_UNACCEPTED
entries.assessment: FAILED + PATCH_PRESENT + RESIDUAL_UNACCEPTED

entries.description: dirty failed task + only ignored/cache/environment mutation uncertainty
entries.criterion: WorkspaceDisposition=STABLE_WITH_UNCERTAINTY；Repository=BASELINE_CLEAN；Patch=NONE
entries.assessment: ignored cache side effect 与 Git-clean 正交

entries.description: quiescence proof missing after mutating failure
entries.criterion: Workspace=QUARANTINED；禁止 workspace-touching finalizer
entries.assessment: QUARANTINED 不能检查 final Git

entries.description: QUARANTINED 但已有 pre-quarantine RepositoryChangeSet evidence
entries.criterion: TaskResult 可引用旧 trusted artifact，但不得声明为重新观察的 current snapshot
entries.assessment: 实际历史 RepositoryChangeSet EvidenceRef 保留在 last_trusted_evidence_refs；QUARANTINED 不执行任何当前 Git probe

entries.description: Review REQUEST_CHANGES after valid Writer patch
entries.criterion: Task FAILED；patch 保留为 RESIDUAL_UNACCEPTED，不伪装 accepted
entries.assessment: Runtime-injected typed ReviewGate 产生 source-bound ReviewVerdict(kind REVIEW_VERDICT) + REQUEST_CHANGES；Task FAILED，真实 Git patch 为 RESIDUAL_UNACCEPTED；伪造执行身份被拒绝

entries.description: AcceptanceFailure + mutation + legal deterministic Repair
entries.criterion: Node=REMEDIATION_PENDING；不提前 task-wide fail closed
entries.assessment: 实际 WRITE mutation + Runtime canonical AcceptanceFailure 合法进入 REMEDIATION_PENDING，首次不 task fail-close

entries.description: Repair budget exhausted while repository patch remains
entries.criterion: Task=FAILED；Workspace→FROZEN；residual patch reported
entries.assessment: 第二次 actual WRITE/acceptance failed 耗尽 repair_count，Task FAILED，FROZEN，残余 tracked patch TaskEvidenceRef 及最新 Acceptance EvidenceRefs 可追溯

entries.description: terminal dirty fail-close state transaction
entries.criterion: failing node FAILED + task FAILED + dispatch closed + remaining nodes BLOCKED 原子化
entries.assessment: _fail_close_locked 在 SchedulerStateMutex 一次事务中发布 TaskLogicalStatus=FAILED、gate epoch、failing Node 和 blocked nodes；仅 quiescence 后 FROZEN/final TaskResult

entries.description: Task FAILED + 10 blocked descendants
entries.criterion: TaskResult.root_failures 只记录真实 root；blocked nodes 作为 propagation consequences
entries.assessment: 1 root + 10 blocked consequences

entries.description: terminal TaskResult final_repository_changeset
entries.criterion: 使用 TaskEvidenceRef 指向 immutable artifact，不复制完整 patch bytes
entries.assessment: TaskEvidenceRef 指向 ChangeSet，不拷贝 patch bytes

entries.description: FROZEN finalizer 生成 final repository changeset
entries.criterion: 使用 task-scoped TaskEvidenceRef；不伪造 synthetic Node attempt
entries.assessment: Task scope evidence，无 synthetic Node attempt

entries.description: TaskEvidenceRef 被尝试放入 NodeHandoff
entries.criterion: schema/policy reject；task-finalization evidence 不进入 ordinary execution handoff
entries.assessment: Pydantic schema 拒绝 TaskEvidenceRef→NodeHandoff

entries.description: QUARANTINED task finalization
entries.criterion: 不创建声称 current-final 的 TaskEvidenceRef；仅保留 last_trusted attempt EvidenceRef
entries.assessment: 隔离不读 Git / 仅 last trusted refs

entries.description: Writer reopen 时 downstream READY 且尚无 dispatch ticket
entries.criterion: accepted authority revoke 后 consumer → PENDING；无 attempt
entries.assessment: READY 无 ticket 返回 PENDING

entries.description: downstream ticket=PREPARING 时 Writer reopen
entries.criterion: ticket REVOKED；prepared result discard；不创建 NodeAttemptRecord
entries.assessment: PREPARING revoke 无 attempt

entries.description: downstream ticket=WAITING_WORKSPACE 时 Writer reopen
entries.criterion: lock wait 被取消/退出；ticket REVOKED；无 backend cancel
entries.assessment: WAITING revoke 无 backend cancel

entries.description: downstream 已拿 lock、ticket=LOCKED_PRECOMMIT，reopen 先取得 SchedulerStateMutex
entries.criterion: ticket REVOKED；consumer commit gate 失败并释放 lock；无 attempt
entries.assessment: LOCKED_PRECOMMIT revoke + commit fail

entries.description: downstream final dispatch commit 先取得 SchedulerStateMutex
entries.criterion: consumer → RUNNING/COMMITTED；Writer reopen → REPAIR_SCOPE_INVALIDATED(ACTIVE_DOWNSTREAM_DISPATCH)
entries.assessment: commit 赢则 scope invalidated

entries.description: Writer reopen transaction 先于 consumer commit
entries.criterion: acceptance_epoch/handoff authority 改变；consumer commit 看到 stamp mismatch，不进入 backend
entries.assessment: reopen 赢则 commit 无 authority

entries.description: consumer COMMITTED 但 DeerFlow 尚 PRE_START/排队 capacity
entries.criterion: P1 仍视为跨越 dispatch boundary；不 retract attempt 后 repair
entries.assessment: PRE_START 仍视为 COMMITTED

entries.description: ACTIVE_DOWNSTREAM_DISPATCH 导致 task fail-close
entries.criterion: 先 close dispatch gate，再 cancel/join committed consumer；全部 quiescent 后才 FROZEN
entries.assessment: failclose + cancel/join → FROZEN

entries.description: active consumer cancellation 无法证明 quiescence
entries.criterion: Workspace→QUARANTINED；不得继续 repair/final workspace inspection
entries.assessment: 未完成 join 则 QUARANTINED

entries.description: Writer H1 publish→reopen→H2 publish
entries.criterion: acceptance_epoch 1→2→3；旧 epoch=1 ticket 永久失效
entries.assessment: epoch 1→2→3 旧票不能恢复

entries.description: task-wide fail-close 时已有 WAITING/LOCKED_PRECOMMIT tickets
entries.criterion: TaskDispatchGate epoch 改变；所有旧 ticket commit fail
entries.assessment: 真实物理 WRITE lock 下 WAITING + LOCKED_PRECOMMIT 同时存在；fail-close 同一 gate epoch 撤销两票且禁止 commit；额外测试 stuck holder timeout → QUARANTINED

entries.description: prepare_node 期间 ticket 被 revoke
entries.criterion: prepare_node 不产生 model/tool/workspace side effect；结果可直接 discard
entries.assessment: asyncio.Event 阻塞 prepare_node，期间 fail-close；恢复后无 attempt / execute / Workspace 访问；票据保持 REVOKED

entries.description: SchedulerStateMutex 持有期间
entries.criterion: 不等待 Workspace lock/backend capacity/I/O；避免 SchedulerMutex→Workspace 反向等待
entries.assessment: threading.Event 同步慢 EvidenceChecker 在 to_thread 中执行；不持 SchedulerStateMutex / 不阻塞 event loop；并发 fail-close 及时发布且旧票不能 commit

entries.description: source Verification failure 触发合法 reopen
entries.criterion: source Verification→REMEDIATION_PENDING；repair success 后同 Node 用 REVERIFY fresh attempt
entries.assessment: same logical node REPAIR→REVERIFY

entries.description: running consumer 被 fail-close cancel 且留下 mutation
entries.criterion: consumer 不是业务 root failure，但 mutation evidence 影响最终 Workspace/Repository disposition
entries.assessment: 已运行 Consumer 被 scope-invalidated fail-close cancel+join，Node CANCELLED 非业务 root；真实 Git 副作用为 RESIDUAL_UNACCEPTED 并记 secondary diagnostics；不静止则 QUARANTINED

entries.description: same WorkspaceRevision R，Writer H1 已 revoke 但 repair 尚未修改 workspace
entries.criterion: revision check alone would pass；acceptance_epoch/handoff stamp 必须阻止旧 consumer commit
entries.assessment: same physical revision 下旧 epoch fence

entries.description: Writer logical success publication 与 downstream READY recompute 并发
entries.criterion: accepted_attempt/handoff + acceptance_epoch increment + READY recompute 在同一 SchedulerStateMutex transaction
entries.assessment: asyncio.Event 冻结 Writer trusted acceptance；consumer 尚 PENDING 时拒绝 claim；接受公布后 READY + accepted_attempt + accepted_handoff + epoch 原子一致

entries.description: READY Node claim 与 Writer reopen 并发
entries.criterion: READY check + dependency stamps capture + single ticket claim 原子化；ticket 不混合两代 authority
entries.assessment: SchedulerMutex 排队使 claim 赢得旧完整 stamp，reopen 随即 revoke；反序 reopen 先赢时 claim 不可再用旧 epoch；两路径均无非法 attempt

entries.description: task-wide cancellation 时 Git-visible patch 已存在
entries.criterion: Task=CANCELLED；PatchDisposition=RESIDUAL_UNACCEPTED，不得 ACCEPTED
entries.assessment: CANCELLED + residual patch 非 ACCEPTED

entries.description: task-wide cancellation 后无法证明 active execution quiescence
entries.criterion: Task=CANCELLED；WorkspaceDisposition=QUARANTINED；不读取 final workspace
entries.assessment: 真实 task-wide cancellation+unquiescent fake backend，TaskResult CANCELLED + QUARANTINED，Git state/change capture 被负测禁用
